mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ADMIN_ACCOUNT ( USER_ID, APPROVAL_STATUS, ADMIN_GRADE, CREATED_AT, CREATED_BY, UPDATED_AT, UPDATED_BY ) VALUES ( #{userId}, 'PENDING', 'GENERAL', NOW(), #{userId}, NOW(), #{userId} )
mapper.select: SELECT USER_ID, APPROVAL_STATUS, ADMIN_GRADE, APPROVED_BY, APPROVED_AT, REJECT_REASON, CREATED_AT FROM ADMIN_ACCOUNT WHERE USER_ID = #{userId}

SELECT ( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT u.USER_ID) FROM USERS u JOIN USER_ROLES ur ON ur.USER_ID = u.USER_ID WHERE u.DELETED_YN = 'N' AND ur.ROLE = 'ROLE_USER' ) AS userCount, ( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT u.USER_ID) FROM USERS u JOIN USER_ROLES ur ON ur.USER_ID = u.USER_ID WHERE u.DELETED_YN = 'N' AND ur.ROLE IN ( 'ROLE_ADMIN', 'ROLE_SUPER_ADMIN' ) ) AS adminCount, ( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT aa.USER_ID) FROM ADMIN_ACCOUNT aa JOIN USERS u ON u.USER_ID = aa.USER_ID WHERE u.DELETED_YN = 'N' AND aa.APPROVAL_STATUS = 'PENDING' ) AS pendingAdminRequestCount
mapper.update: UPDATE ADMIN_ACCOUNT SET APPROVAL_STATUS = 'APPROVED', ADMIN_GRADE = 'GENERAL', APPROVED_BY = #{approvedBy}, APPROVED_AT = NOW(), REJECT_REASON = NULL, UPDATED_AT = NOW(), UPDATED_BY = #{approvedBy} WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} AND APPROVAL_STATUS = 'PENDING'

UPDATE ADMIN_ACCOUNT SET APPROVAL_STATUS = 'REJECTED', REJECT_REASON = #{rejectReason}, APPROVED_BY = #{approvedBy}, APPROVED_AT = NOW(), UPDATED_AT = NOW(), UPDATED_BY = #{approvedBy} WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} AND APPROVAL_STATUS = 'PENDING'
